run_generate_opus_samples: run the script to convert an input audio file into individual 160-byte Opus sample files
run_ogg_parser: run the Ogg parser to read and parse Ogg page segments from an Ogg audio stream file
build_opus_generator: build a tool that uses ffmpeg to encode audio to Opus and split it into individual sample files
refactor_generate_function: refactor the generate function to support configurable sample sizes and output formats
review_ogg_class: review the Ogg and Page classes that parse Ogg bitstream pages using KaitaiStruct
